referenceSources.description:
A white and black two-tone AE86 Trueno is showcased outside Ace Station in Kanagawa Prefecture. The front view reveals its iconic pop-up headlights—one raised, one lowered—flanking a black grille with the "TRUENO" emblem. A bright yellow "A-STATION" plate hangs below, indicating the specialist AE86 dealer.

This classic coupe is equipped with a Fujitsubo Legalis exhaust, Recaro racing seats, a Nardi steering wheel, and 14-inch Tomei wheels on aftermarket suspension with adjustable lateral links. The listing notes a fully cleaned engine bay and interior, 129,000 km of use, and a documented repair history. Ace Station offers detailed inspection, financing options, and a meticulous pre-delivery preparation process, backed by a perfect customer satisfaction rating.
